message:
fix(OP-03): share lossless effective engine settings with RC6 intent sizing

Preserve zeros, rounding, warmup and execution flags; hash and validate transported settings. Both transports bind the same effective config to the delegated handler; supply close/equity projections for fixed/cash/percent sizing. Core engine zero-margin support and declaration-version defaults remain separate acceptance gaps.
